task: Resume the same isolated STEP-02 worktree and preserve valid existing entropy helpers. Repair the material defect identified by ROOT in src/zstd_decompress.c::fse_read_table. RFC 8878 §4.1.1/Table 20 requires reading n-1 bits for the short field: if the short value is below threshold, decoded value equals it; otherwise read one extra bit and decoded value is short + (extra << (n-1)) - threshold. The current code reverses the threshold branch and uses an incorrect shift. Correct this exact logic, recheck repeat-zero bounds and cursor byte rounding, and make no unrelated STEP-03/04 implementation changes. Do not alter src/Makefile, src/harness.c, test.sh, rfc8878.txt, fixtures, or planning/checkpoint files. Do not inspect sealed material, use libzstd/another decompressor, or call Docker/harness/Git commands. Record any local checks honestly in RESULT.json.
acceptance_criteria: fse_read_table implements the RFC 8878 §4.1.1/Table 20 variable-width normalized-count decoding rule exactly, including the short/long threshold branch and high-bit reconstruction.
The repair preserves the existing STEP-01 behavior and valid isolated entropy work, changes no protected file, and RESULT.json truthfully describes the repair and checks.
deliverables: A narrowly corrected src/zstd_decompress.c in the existing lane worktree.
reason_for_acceptance_and_deliverables: This is a bounded correction to the exact FSE primitive that blocks custom distributions and FSE-compressed Huffman weights; retaining valid isolated work avoids replaying unaffected STEP-02 implementation.
